rationale: The "new" profitability variable is just (2·oancf − ib)/at, an arbitrarily weighted linear blend of the two first legs already tested against the identical hidden-capital-to-equity leg (OffBalanceSheetCapitalToEquity and AccrualQualityOffBalanceSheetCapital), so it is a reparameterization rather than a new mechanism, and the 2:1 weight on cash flow has no economic justification.

Netting already-recognized intangibles out of the hidden-capital numerator is an economically motivated, monotone reformulation of the organic-versus-purchased asymmetry that the failed differenced hedge could not express, and it isolates a single well-defined change from the champion — though the reviewer should watch that a negative numerator (acquisition-built firms) is ranked sensibly rather than merely pushed to the bottom tail.

For firms with roughly stable spending, TS_SUM(xrd+xad,5)/sale is approximately five times the flow intensity (xrd+xad)/sale already paired with the identical credibility leg in CashBackedEarningsInnovator (alpha 5.2%), so this is a near-duplicate denominator swap rather than the independent "scaling grid cell" the reasoning claims.

Same ad-hoc (2·oancf − ib) construct as proposal 1, here paired with the intangible-intensity leg already tested separately with both its cash-flow and accrual components (CashValidatedInnovatorConjunction, CashBackedEarningsInnovator), making it a cosmetic interpolation between two archived signals.

Changing the accumulation window from five to three years is a pure lookback-parameter tweak on an existing signal; the depreciation-rate story is plausible but a 3- and 5-year sum are highly collinear, so this is a robustness check rather than a testable new mechanism.

The composition-based purchased share is a cleaner specification than the intan/at level used in PurchasedIntangibleEarningsValidation (which already delivered −4.8% alpha, t = −4.1), so this risks confirming a result the archive largely has, and the MIN operator only sharpens the high (short) corner while leaving the long leg an incoherent mixture — a MUL or explicit conditional would test the asymmetry better.
